howto.1.body: You pick a team, so does your opponent. It starts when you're both ready. You can't see their pick until the countdown ends.
howto.2.body: A three-second countdown, then both teams are revealed and the keyboard opens.
howto.3.body: Type a player who played for both teams. Tapping a suggestion sends it. You get the round time you picked. Example: Sneijder, Icardi, Podolski.
howto.4.body: You're locked for 5 seconds. You also see your opponent's wrong guesses.
howto.5.body: A team can be named once per match. If the two teams share no player, the round isn't played and you pick again; three in a row ends the match in a draw. Not picking a team within 45 seconds loses the round.

scope.path_note: In this mode the scope means: players whose career passed through it at least once
learn.ladder.1: Two clubs appear. Type a player who played for both and tap the suggestion.
learn.ladder.2: You have 3 lives. A wrong guess or running out of time costs one; the run ends when they're gone.
learn.ladder.3: Early steps give you 20 seconds. Later the time gets shorter and the clubs more obscure. Fast answers earn bonus points.
learn.blitz.1: Two clubs and five names appear. Only one of the five played for both clubs: tap it. No keyboard.
learn.blitz.2: You have one life. The first mistake or timeout ends the run.
learn.blitz.3: Consecutive correct answers build a combo that multiplies your score. Questions keep getting faster.
learn.career.1: A player's career is shown starting from his first club; a new club is revealed every few seconds.
learn.career.2: Type who it is. The earlier you get it, the more points you earn.
learn.career.3: You have 3 lives. A wrong guess, or running out of time after all clubs are shown, costs one.
learn.chain.1: The player is given. First type his first professional club.
learn.chain.2: Then type every club he moved to, in order. Each step gives hints: year, transfer type, fee, country and league.
learn.chain.3: 20 seconds per step and 3 lives in total. On a miss the right club is shown and you move to the next step.
learn.versus.1: Two players and a question appear. Tap the one with the higher number.
learn.versus.2: Get it right and a new pair comes up. Fast answers earn bonus points.
learn.versus.3: The first mistake or timeout ends the run.
weekly.title: Match of the week
weekly.note: Each question has one player from each club: who has the higher number in his club's shirt? Your score goes to your side's total.
weekly.pick_note: Your side stays for the whole week
cat.w_apps: Who made more appearances for his club?
cat.w_goals: Who scored more goals for his club?
cat.w_assists: Who made more assists for his club?

cat.w_seasons: Who played more seasons for his club?
learn.weekly.1: Each question has one player from each club. The numbers are what he did in that club's shirt: appearances, goals, assists, yellow cards, seasons. Tap the higher one.
learn.weekly.2: You pick a side when you enter; it stays for the whole week. Every run's score is added to your side's total.
learn.weekly.3: Keep going while you're right; fast answers earn bonus points. The first mistake or timeout ends the run.
